# Copilot Instructions: Conduit Fill APK

- Adhere to National Electrical Code (NEC) tables and standards for conductor dimensions and conduit cross-sectional areas.
- Maintain backwards compatibility with standard Android SDK versions (API 26+).
- Ensure all conduit calculation functions are pure, unit-tested, and resilient against invalid conductor sizes or division by zero.
- Keep the UI responsive and optimized for field use by electricians.
